function.name: MAP_EXISTS
function.param: Number of graph inside of library
function.abstract: It returns 1 if a graph exists

description.p: This function returns 1 if a graph exists inside of the library indicated. Only can have 1000 graphs in a library, with codes of 0 to 999, it is possible to use this function inside of a loop, repeat... to enumerate all graphs that exist inside of FPG library.
